initial_sector: Total photon number exactly two in ten modes, classical initial R/D memory; separately labelled source Kraus instrument and nominal ordered passive maps
constraint: At each bin k, the coefficient of |2_p_k> after W_k must vanish on the surviving two-photon branch. Previous two-photon branches have vacuum at each consumed detector port. Any absorption reduces total number to <=1 and is automatically locally safe thereafter.
rows: c0=<2_p0|Gamma(W0); c1=<2_p1|Gamma(W1)P_vac(p0)Gamma(W0); c2=<2_p2|Gamma(W2)P_vac(p1)Gamma(W1)P_vac(p0)Gamma(W0), restricted to initial N=2
safe_space: Intersection ker(c0) intersect ker(c1) intersect ker(c2), with the factorial occupation metric retained
maximality: The zero-absorption no-click branch has nonzero amplitude for either classical initial memory. Violation of any earliest row produces positive forbidden two-photon support at that detector. Conversely vanishing rows makes every prefix safe; absorbed branches have N<=1.
scope: Initial-state subspace for this fixed ordered three-round schedule, not an invariant subspace under arbitrary passive operations or a new physical preparation authority
density_extension: Positive density operators supported on the safe subspace obey the same criterion by spectral decomposition; mixtures cannot cancel positive forbidden probability mass.
old_overlap_status: The accepted total-N<=1 overlap catalog is unchanged; this is an additional conditional mathematical domain candidate, not admitted physical sector transport
